definition.en: The Human Poverty Index (HPI) is a composite index that measures the extent of deprivation in basic human development dimensions, focusing on longevity, knowledge, and a decent standard of living.
definition.hi: The Human Poverty Index (HPI) is a composite index that measures the extent of deprivation in basic human development dimensions, focusing on longevity, knowledge, and a decent standard of living.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding HPI is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it provides a multidimensional perspective on poverty beyond mere income metrics. It helps aspirants analyze social sector performance and policy effectiveness in the Indian economy.
